title: PC Express (Multimedia Informatica)
description:
IT services / hosted email provider · Italy
Leaked 9 November 2026, 17:49 UTC
This disclosure concerns a verified set of records from a hosted email and IT services provider in Italy. The material scheduled for publication comprises the hosted mail database, covering more than 24,000 mailboxes of the provider's client organizations, together with business correspondence and internal documents. Representative records have been examined and verified as genuine. Once published, the complete data set can be examined, downloaded, and redistributed without restriction.
